purpose: Build FIRST source-to-owned-weights-typed-index-relational-invariant-to-independent-universal-SMT-proof execution interface without reading or consuming G3 reserved original array8. This is necessary architecture, NOT full Q3 proof.
north_star: Frontier-level problem solving with minimum necessary computation
admissible_synthetic_programs: FILL store destination[i]=constant; COPY store destination[i]=source[i]; ADD store destination[i]=source[i]+constant. strong_classical_baseline: Deterministic source-to-invariant AST compiler with exact same source rights, plus same independent source verifier. It can outperform NN; no equal-rights model exclusivity claim unless externally demonstrated.
metrics: Exact heldout generated AST structure, actual universal SMT certificates, ablation with randomly initialized weights, native classical source compiler, neural full training/inference/proof ms vs classical compile/proof ms (single hosted Actions runtime; no reliable energy).
